strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
We're here! Enemies north, south, east and west! What a pain... huh?
Whaaat!? How!?
So this is the place in question. ...Heh, I see.
What's with that knowing look, Tetsuya... wait, whaaat!?
It seems the identification signals weren't mistaken after all...
Damn, they really are Hyakki robots!
You mean the Hyakki Empire's still around!?
Impossible. I know we finished them off back then...!
Oh no! This makes no sense at all!
Brother, this is no time to panic!
Then we'll just have to find out...! Let's go, Hayato! Benkei!
Chaaange Dragon! Switch on!
Look, everyone! Is that... a Flying Tank!?
No doubt about it.
Whaaat, then doesn't that mean Gil is nearby!?
I don't know. But... let's head out.
Let's go, everyone!
Crooooss Fight! Dan-Gai-Ohhh!
Hyoma! There's definitely a Campbellian Magma Beast here too...!
What's goin' on here!? We beat the Campbellians' big boss, didn't we!?
Kosuke! Can you figure anything out!?
...I don't know. But... that's definitely the Magma Beast Demon!
It's not some other robot with its outer shell swapped!
No time for all this yappin'! We gotta find out! Let's go, Hyoma!
All right, let's move out!
Let's...! Coooombiiiine!
Everyone just charged out on their own...
It can't be helped. It'd be a grave matter for anyone. Besides...
Mixed in with all of them... the Einst? They're here too... hm!?
A heat source... from underground!?
That's...!? From the Devil Gundam!?
Wh-what's it doing in a place like this!?
Domon! We'll go too...
Come fooorth!! Gundaaam!!
An enemy force this size... and the one leading it...
...In... the... way...
So it is...! It can talk!?
Nanbu, what's wrong?
Captain Amuro, didn't you hear that?
Hm... hear what?
...No, never mind. ...No choice but to head out...!
Ah, Kyosuke!
What's with him? Cham, do you sense something from that enemy?
Yeah... something like an aura of malice... no, I don't know... I don't!
Anyway, let's head out too.
We've met that enemy before, but it's too full of mysteries... and...
...That red machine... Alchemie...
Once it shows up, we might learn something.
All units, launch! Cast aside your doubts and focus on the enemy!
What the hell, there's still more of 'em!?
Ah! Big Bro! Look at that!
That's Bancs!
What the hell's going on? Robots from every army are showing up...!
Ah! That's one of the Gaizok's...!
Hm... come to think of it... they escorted that dogu-like battleship...
Mecha Boosts!
How do you know about them?
Back when we were out in space, that Butcher guy
...used to mess with us all the time.
Kappei and the others... I wonder if they won...
Mister! That thing!
Madanga... was it? Tch, what's going on here!
Not that I ever bought that the Demon Empire was really gone!
And Akira's up in space...
Heh, guess we'll just rip the masks off the whole lot of 'em!
Tobikage!
Even that guy's here? Enemies and allies alike, what a lineup.
Koji, isn't Tobikage acting... strange?
It always shows up in a pinch, as if it was watching. ...Hm?
It's... not moving? Tobikage...
Ah! I've got it!
That mysterious enemy is emitting, beyond our range of hearing,
...something like sound waves!
I see. What these enemies share is that none of them have cockpits...
They're AI-controlled robots! And that enemy can control them...!
If Tobikage is reacting... does that mean Tobikage runs on AI too!?
If that's the case... this is bad. We'll have to fight it.
Don't tell me... against a robot that evasive...!?
You idiot! Tobikage! Don't show up at the worst possible time!
...You sure changed your tune fast, Joe...
This signal... it's combining!
It wasn't controlled after all!
That's Tobikage for ya!
...Aren't you the fair-weather friend.
This signal... it's combining!
It wasn't controlled after all!
That's Tobikage for ya!
...Aren't you the fair-weather friend.
This signal... it's combining!
It wasn't controlled after all!
That's Tobikage for ya!
...Aren't you the fair-weather friend.
More reinforcements!?
That's...! The Alteisen!?
So that's the Alteisen that showed up in space!?
I see. It does look similar... but in the end, it's just a fake...
No... it's not a fake... It's something more... different.
What...!?
It's been a while... Kyosuke.
You...!
That's...!? Isn't that the one that showed up in Byston Well!?
Don't tell me it means to open the Aura Road again?
Byston Well... we're finished there... Our goal is...
What on earth is going on?
Kyosuke... Excellen... you will come... with me...
Excellen and I... you want us to come with you...? Where!?
...To a new... universe... to cast away the land of beginnings...
I don't know what you're talking about.
...You think I'll just do whatever you want?
Yes... you will do as I wish...
...What!? Ngh, my head...!!
What's wrong!? Nanbu!
That red machine is giving off powerful psychic waves of some kind!
Impossible!? Just as it controls AIs, it's doing the same to Nanbu...! Absurd.
...Kyosuke... why... do you...?
I told you... I won't do... what you want...!
Why...? Your body is... ours...
(What is she babbling about...!)
Are you all right!? Kyosuke!
Yeah...
A red machine... wasn't that the one Excellen also...!?
No clue what's going on, but let's just take out that red machine!
All units, concentrate your attacks on that red machine.
Kyo...suke... why...? I... about you...
For me... to be me... I need... Kyosuke... and Excellen...
For you to be you...? What does that mean!? What are you!?
(What are you trying to tell me!? This girl...)
This is farewell... Kyosuke.
Wait! I still have questions for you!
What a pity... So... it will have to be... Excellen...
What...? What did you just say!?
(Damn... I don't get it! Her goal, and the Einst... I can't see it...!
Excellen, be careful.)
...It's over. Still...
That Einst coming after Nanbu... I can't make sense of its behavior.
Apparently it's been showing up around Excellen a lot, too...
Any idea why?
I don't know... It said something about needing me and Excellen...
Maybe you're just her type?
Kyosuke's a pretty good-looking guy, after all.
Hold on, Lamba. Then where does that leave Excellen?
(Excellen and me... Is she connected to that accident too...?)
